Frequently asked questions

Is my gift secure?

Yes. Online gifts go through Zeffy, a Canadian platform that never shares your card details with us.

Why Zeffy?

Zeffy is free for charities: no fees are taken from your gift. The platform suggests an optional tip, which you can set to $0.

Can I give monthly?

Yes, the Zeffy form offers monthly giving, which you can change or cancel at any time.

Will I get a tax receipt?

If the association is registered with the CRA, yes: the receipt is emailed to you [to confirm].

La Paix du Cœur Kimia Na Motema
